en: Black‑and‑white landscape view across a calm river or lake toward a small European town. Dominating the scene is a tall, slender neo‑Gothic church with a high central tower and spire, flanked by lower church roofs and surrounding townhouses. A row of evenly planted trees lines the embankment below the church. Industrial chimneys and additional buildings appear to the right, while dense trees and shrubs edge the water in the foreground. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image side.
